title: Where does AI actually sit in a manufacturing workflow?
summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming the manufacturing landscape by optimizing decision-making and boosting productivity. Companies are embracing AI for efficient inventory control and effective product launches, enhancing their operational workflows. With AI-driven analytics, forecasting accuracy improves as it seamlessly connects varied data sources. Market insights generated through AI empower businesses to make strategic pricing and positioning choices. A robust foundation with measurable results can facilitate successful AI integration throughout their operations.
